source.calculus: Closed Route Empty and bit Term Empty from DependentTransportMachine; stay, turn and follow, with independently defined idle/flip/split/under reductions.
source.target_routes: All finite generated type paths at Bool: refl, ua(Boolean flip equivalence), and path composition. Not every path in the universe.
source.target_packages: For each generated p, the marked filled triangle (p, inverse p, refl, cancellation witness), with all three vertices Bool.
source.continuation: For every b:Bool, transport b along the retained first edge. Typed package comparisons induce probe equalities and higher comparisons induce equalities of those equalities.
source.inverse_source: Reverse the source route order, keeping turn self-inverse; both source recovery laws are proved by recursion.
source.common_mark: The source route and actual diagram/result/execution trace are retained together in Completed(p). No geometric barycenter is asserted.
source.resource_scope: Finite execution traces are constructed for every closed route and input; no physical resources or uniform runtime bound asserted.

conjectures.statement: Every closed source route has a constructed filled triangle, correct witness-consuming Boolean continuations on every input, finite execution traces, reversible source and semantic actions, and preservation of route composition and typed higher package comparisons.
conjectures.acceptance: Fresh safe Cubical dependency closure with source/compiler inventories and stable inputs; no universal kernel verdict for unrelated source classes.
conjectures.falsifier: An admitted generated route fails construction, machine-to-transport agreement, finite trace, inverse law or required composition/comparison law.

conjectures.statement: A function of only the retained return diagonal can reproduce the false-input first-edge transport probe for every source-generated triangle.
conjectures.falsifier: The stay and turn triangles have identical vertices and diagonal refl, but the probe returns false and true respectively.

scope_boundary: Nontrivial first-edge path witnesses in an ambient universe, with actual filled 2-cells and higher comparison preservation. Does not exhibit two distinct 2-cell fillers with every edge fixed, derive univalence from the source, or prove universal higher-foundation coverage.
relation_to_finite_bit_instance: Strengthening the continuation interface to consume retained path evidence, not a logical consequence of finite set-level synthesis.
